mapper.select: SELECT sandbox.organization_uuid, sandbox.workspace_uuid, sandbox.uuid AS sandbox_uuid, s.external_id AS session_id, cs.external_id AS code_session_id, cs.work_dir, COALESCE(cs.metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}', '') AS transport, sandbox.manager_resume_phase AS phase, sandbox.manager_version AS version FROM environment_sandboxes sandbox JOIN environment_work work ON work.uuid=sandbox.work_uuid AND work.organization_uuid=sandbox.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid=sandbox.workspace_uuid JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid=work.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid=work.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid=work.workspace_uuid JOIN LATERAL (SELECT code.external_id, code.work_dir, code.metadata FROM code_sessions code WHERE code.session_uuid=s.uuid AND code.organization_uuid=s.organization_uuid AND code.workspace_uuid=s.workspace_uuid AND code.status='active' AND code.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY code.id DESC LIMIT 1) cs ON true WHERE sandbox.workspace_uuid=#{workspaceUUID} AND sandbox.provider_sandbox_id=#{providerID} AND sandbox.state='running' AND work.state='active' AND work.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.status <> 'terminated'
mapper.sql: organization_uuid=#{target.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid=#{target.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid=#{target.SandboxUUID} AND state='running'
mapper.update: UPDATE environment_sandboxes SET manager_resume_phase=#{phase}, updated_at=NOW() , tool_call_ready_at=NULL WHERE
